name: Ring Maltese Hold
steps: Set the rings low enough to step down and take a straight-arm support with your hands beside your hips.
Lean forward over the rings as you spread your arms wide and bring your joined legs up behind you.
Level your chest and hips with the rings and hold your body face down with straight elbows.
Lower your feet to the floor under control and release the rings.
tips: Keep pressing downward through both rings as your arms spread.
Avoid letting your hips pike up or sag below shoulder height.
